claims.statement: Ford's Fathom will be the cheapest American EV capable of powering a house.

sources.quote: The Fathom pickup won't need a wall-mounted inverter to output 10 kW to your house.

claims.statement: The Fathom pickup doesn't need a wall-mounted inverter to output 10 kW to a house.

sources.quote: Ford is rolling out two new chargers capable of powering a home or the grid — so-called V2X capability.

claims.statement: Ford is rolling out two new chargers with V2X capability, able to power a home or the grid.

analysis.headline: Ford's $30K Fathom EV can power a house without an inverter
analysis.summary: Ford's Fathom, priced around $30,000, is billed as the cheapest American EV able to power a house, outputting 10 kW without needing a wall-mounted inverter, as Ford rolls out two new V2X-capable chargers for home or grid power.
